_about: W1c giant concepts (25 Nov, owner asleep; art/OVERNIGHT.md C8). The twelve bronze giants 十二金人: bell-stand bearers cast from melted weapons (Shiji), giants in foreign dress at Lintao (Ban Gu). Jobs 0-1 full figure carrying a beam (bell-stand bearer), job 2 head busts (variety for twelve heads), job 3 weapon fragments fused into the cast body. Reference only, never shipped or traced. Same model and LCM settings as rounds B-D.
